resources.string: A dancing whale girl on your home screen. Tap her to switch to the next dance.

The dances for the home screen widget. Pick one here and the widget on your home screen follows right away; tapping the widget itself also moves to the next dance. You can also bring in a GIF of your own.
The built-in dance lives in this app; anything you bring in is a copy kept in %1$s. Deleting a copy never touches the file you picked
Brought in "%1$s" (%2$d frames) - she is on the home screen now
That one did not come in: %1$s
To place her: long press an empty spot on the home screen, open widgets, find Luwi Whale Dance, then drag Whale Dance onto the screen.
